fields.name: url
fields.description: Image URL (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: patentType
fields.description: Patent type: D for a design patent or U for a utility model patent. Default: D

fields.name: model
fields.description: Image-search model. Design patents: 1 (smart association, recommended) or 2 (search this image). Utility model patents: 3 (match shape) or 4 (match shape, pattern, and color; recommended)

fields.name: country
fields.description: Patent authority codes for countries, organizations, or regions, separated by commas, for example CN,US,JP. Omit to search all patent authorities

fields.name: loc
fields.description: LOC classifications (Locarno classification numbers). Join multiple classifications with AND, OR, or NOT

fields.name: legalStatus
fields.description: Comma-separated patent legal-status codes. Values: 1 (published), 2 (substantive examination), 3 (granted), 8 (duplicate-grant avoidance), 11 (withdrawn), 12 (withdrawn-unspecified), 17 (deemed withdrawn), 18 (voluntarily withdrawn), 13 (rejected), 14 (fully revoked), 15 (expired), 16 (annual fee unpaid), 21 (rights restored), 22 (rights terminated), 23 (partially invalid), 24 (application terminated), 30 (abandoned), 19 (deemed abandoned), 20 (voluntarily abandoned), 25 (abandoned-unspecified), 222 (PCT did not enter designated state within designation period), 223 (PCT entered designated state within designation period), 224 (PCT entered designated state after designation period), and 225 (PCT did not enter designated state after designation period)

fields.name: simpleLegalStatus
fields.description: Comma-separated simplified patent legal-status codes. Values: 0 (inactive), 1 (active), 2 (pending), 220 (PCT designation period expired), 221 (within PCT designation period), and 999 (unconfirmed)

fields.name: assignees
fields.description: Applicant or patent owner (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: applyStartTime
fields.description: Patent application start date in yyyyMMdd format

fields.name: applyEndTime
fields.description: Patent application end date in yyyyMMdd format

fields.name: publicStartTime
fields.description: Patent publication start date in yyyyMMdd format

fields.name: publicEndTime
fields.description: Patent publication end date in yyyyMMdd format

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Number of patents to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 10

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Result offset, from 0 to 1,000. Default: 0

fields.name: field
fields.description: Result sort field: SCORE (relevance), APD (application date), PBD (publication date), or ISD (grant date). Default: SCORE

fields.name: order
fields.description: Available when field is APD, PBD, or ISD: desc (descending) or asc (ascending). Default: desc

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Preferred title language: original (original patent title), cn (Chinese-translated title), or en (English-translated title). Default: original

fields.name: preFilter
fields.description: Whether to enable country/LOC pre-filtering: 1 for enabled and 0 for disabled. Default: 1

fields.name: stemming
fields.description: Whether to enable stemming: 1 for enabled and 0 for disabled. Default: 0

fields.name: mainField
fields.description: Primary patent fields, including title, abstract, claims, specification, publication number, application number, applicant, inventor, and IPC/UPC/LOC classifications (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: includeMachineTranslation
fields.description: Include machine-translated data in the search

fields.name: scoreExpansion
fields.description: Score expansion

fields.name: isHttps
fields.description: Whether to return images over HTTPS: 1 for HTTPS and 0 for HTTP. Default: 0

fields.name: returnImgId
fields.description: Whether to return img_id. Default: false
